item.title: A Timeline of Katy Perry & Justin Trudeau’s Relationship
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: Welcome to "Celebrity Scoop"! Today, we're diving into one of the most unexpected celebrity romances of our time. Imagine Katy Perry, the California-born pop star, and Justin Trudeau, the former Canadian prime minister, as a couple. Just a few years ago, this sounded like a wild rumor, but in 2025, it became a reality.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: It all started in the summer of 2025, when whispers, photos, and videos began circulating, linking the two together. As it turned out, they had found love after both experiencing very public breakups. Katy Perry had just split from her long-term partner, Orlando Bloom, after nine years together, while Justin Trudeau had parted ways with his wife, Sophie Grégoire, in 2023, after 18 years of marriage.
[Music transitions to a slightly more serious tone]
Host: According to sources, Katy and Orlando's breakup was a result of shifting priorities, with a focus on co-parenting their daughter, Daisy Dove. Meanwhile, Justin Trudeau was over a year into his bachelor life, and it seems that's when he met Katy. The rest, as they say, is history.
[Music lightens up again]
Host: As the couple continues to share their love with the world, it's clear that they're smitten. Who knew that a California girl like Katy Perry would capture the heart of the former Canadian prime minister? Tune in next time for more updates on this unexpected romance, and don't forget to follow us for the latest celebrity news and scoops!
[Upbeat music returns, fading out as the host says]
Host: Thanks for listening to "Celebrity Scoop"!
